---
title: "Install and set up IntroStatGPT"
---

Complete these steps before you first use IntroStatGPT. You do not need
previous experience with R or computer programming.

## 1. Activate your UT ChatGPT account

UT Austin provides ChatGPT EDU to students, faculty, and staff.

1. Visit the [UT Austin AI tools page](https://tech.utexas.edu/services-tools/ai).
2. Select **Log in to access OpenAI ChatGPT EDU**.
3. Sign in with your UT EID email address: `[your EID]@eid.utexas.edu`.
4. Complete UT authentication.

Use this account when you sign in to the desktop app.

## 2. Install R

R performs the statistical calculations behind IntroStatGPT. Download it from
[The Comprehensive R Archive Network](https://cloud.r-project.org/).

### Windows

1. Select **Download R for Windows**.
2. Select **base**.
3. Download the current R installer.
4. Open the installer and accept the default options.

### Mac

1. Select **Download R for macOS**.
2. Download the installer for your Mac.
3. Open the downloaded `.pkg` file and follow the installation prompts.

To identify your Mac processor, select **Apple menu > About This Mac** and look
for Apple silicon or Intel.

## 3. Install the ChatGPT desktop app

Follow the [official desktop-app instructions](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/app)
to install ChatGPT. Open the app and sign in with your UT ChatGPT account.

## 4. Download IntroStatGPT

Download [IntroStatGPT_intensive.zip](../files/IntroStatGPT_intensive.zip) (13 MB), then extract it.
The extracted folder normally has the same name as the ZIP file.

### Windows

1. Right-click the downloaded ZIP file.
2. Select **Extract All**.
3. Move the extracted IntroStatGPT folder to Documents.

### Mac

1. Double-click the downloaded ZIP file.
2. Move the extracted IntroStatGPT folder to Documents.

Work from the extracted folder. Keep its internal files and folders in their
original locations.

## 5. Open the extracted folder in Codex

1. Open the ChatGPT desktop app.
2. Enter Codex.
3. From the menu bar, choose **File > Open Folder**.
4. Open Documents and select the IntroStatGPT folder you extracted in the
   previous step.
5. Select **Open**.

Select the extracted IntroStatGPT folder itself, rather than a CSV file or one
of its subfolders. Codex now treats that folder and everything inside it as one
workspace.

## 6. Run the initial setup

After the folder opens, start a task for this workspace:

1. In the left sidebar, select **New task** (the **+** button).
2. Confirm that the IntroStatGPT folder name appears as the task's workspace.
3. Set the model and effort. At the bottom right of the message box, next to
   the microphone, a selector shows the current model and effort, for example
   **5.6 Luna Medium**. Click it and set it to **5.6 Luna** with **High**
   effort. Codex remembers this for new tasks, but glance at it each time; lower
   effort settings produce sloppier statistical output.
4. Click the message box and send:

> Set up this IntroStatGPT workspace and verify that it is ready. Do not begin an
> analysis yet.

Codex will check R and install the required R packages. The first setup may take
a few minutes. Approve package installation if Codex requests permission.

Setup is complete when Codex reports:

> Setup check passed.

You are now ready to [use IntroStatGPT](use.qmd).

## Setup troubleshooting

### Codex cannot find R

Close and reopen the ChatGPT desktop app after installing R. Then send:

> Check whether R is installed and available to this workspace.

### An R package is missing

Send:

> Run the workspace setup and install or update any missing or incompatible
> required packages.

### Setup still fails

Send:

> Diagnose the setup failure. Tell me exactly what I need to do, but do not
> begin an analysis.
